source: Corebridge SimpliNow Legacy client brochure AGLC201191 REV1225 (Dec 2025)

products.SimpliNow Legacy Max: level, 100% death benefit day one; terminal illness + nursing home riders (not CA); optional ADB rider
products.SimpliNow Legacy: graded: years 1-2 death benefit = 110% of premiums paid, full after year 2

faceAmounts: $5,000-$35,000 by age/product; aggregate SimpliNow Legacy Max + Legacy + GIWL per person capped at $25,000
limitedPay: premiums stop at a maximum payment age (never above 95); policy endows at 100. Examples: issue 65 Max male NT 95, male tobacco 91, female 95; issue 70 graded male 94, female 95
